leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a service to manage HTTP request deduplication in Angular
Configure a caching mechanism to store and retrieve pending API requests
Construct a reusable interceptor that prevents duplicate HTTP calls
Apply request deduplication logic to optimize application performance
Initialize and manage shared observable streams for concurrent requests
Integrate deduplication patterns into existing Angular service architectures
Manipulate HTTP request flows to eliminate redundant network calls
